description: Scaffold a new FastAPI service with uv (`uv init --bare` + `uv add` with the pinned ranges of the author's docs: `fastapi[standard]>=0.142.2,<0.143.0`, Pydantic 2, pydantic-settings, SQLModel or plain SQLAlchemy 2.0 async on asyncpg/aiosqlite, Alembic), or bring an existing FastAPI service up to this catalog's toolchain, then lay down a real, tested skeleton: the layered `app/` package (`main.py` app factory + lifespan, `settings.py` with `env_prefix="APP_"` and `SecretStr`, `dependencies.py` `Annotated` aliases, `db.py`, `routers/`, `services/` with a `Protocol` port, `data/` adapters, `models/`), `/healthz` + `/readyz`, one sample CRUD resource (router → service → repository) with fast tests on in-memory SQLite and a testcontainers PostgreSQL integration tier (`@pytest.mark.integration`), Alembic with an async `env.py`, a naming convention and a reviewed initial revision, optional PyJWT + pwdlib[argon2] auth, `scripts/export_openapi.py`, Sphinx API docs sources in `docs/api/`, a multi-stage non-root uv `Dockerfile` + `.dockerignore` + `compose.yaml` (postgres:18, one-shot `migrate`, app), `.env.example`, `sonar-project.properties` when Sonar is enabled, and every tool config in `pyproject.toml` (Ruff, mypy strict + pydantic plugin, pytest markers, coverage 80% with XML at `build/coverage/coverage.xml`) exactly as the Python scaffold contract the `iru-python-*` gates and `iru-setup-python-github-workflows` rely on. Invoke as `/iru-setup-python-fastapi`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `name`, `package`, `description`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `python-version`, `database` (`postgresql`/`sqlite`/`none`), `orm` (`sqlmodel`/`sqlalchemy`), `auth` (`yes`/`no`), `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `distribution`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — so `iru-setup-python-repository` can drive it without re-prompting; stand-alone it asks whatever `args` didn't resolve. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating an existing service and, for every artifact it owns that already exists, warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace (or Stop). Ends by running the contract's canonical commands (uv sync, ruff, mypy, fast + integration pytest, coverage, Alembic checks, Sphinx, OpenAPI export, uv build, docker build). Use whenever a repository needs a FastAPI service bootstrapped with its full test/lint/type/migration/container toolchain from this house template, instead of wiring it by hand.
